title: Let the first minute pass
idea: A strong urge often softens if you wait one minute before acting on it.
explanation: Strong reactions feel urgent because they arrive all at once. A short pause gives your thinking time to catch up, and you often choose differently.
action: Next time you feel a sharp urge to reply or snap, wait one full minute first.
source: Inspired by The Chimp Paradox, Professor Steve Peters

title: Make it small enough to start
idea: A habit becomes easier to keep when the first step is almost too small to refuse.
explanation: Big goals often stall at the start. Shrinking the first step removes the friction, and momentum does the rest.
action: Choose one habit you've been putting off and shrink it to two minutes today.
source: Inspired by Atomic Habits, James Clear

title: Sort what is yours to control
idea: Much of our stress comes from worrying about things we cannot change.
explanation: Separating what you can influence from what you cannot brings your energy back to the things you can act on.
action: Write down one worry today, then mark whether it is within your control.
